name: CrushOn AI
summary: Unfiltered character chat with a large community card library and a testable free tier, currently held off our recommended list over reported billing, cancellation, and privacy red flags.
ranking_rationale: First-party pricing documents unlimited access to designated free models, 100 monthly credits, 8K free memory, and a $5.99 monthly Standard plan. Despite testable free access, reported cancellation friction, non-refundable terms, processor churn, and heavy tracker counts keep it off our recommended Top 10.

pricing.free_tier: 100 monthly credits + unlimited designated free models, 8K memory

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Verified by selecting Monthly in the live pricing page. 16K-memory models, 4,000 pinned characters per chat, voice features.

plans.name: Standard (annual)
plans.notes: $4.91/mo effective. The site's $4.9/mo headline is annual billing — do not read it as month-to-month.

pricing.notes: Free chat history is deleted after 7 days of inactivity; paid history retained during membership. Annual is promotional and can change.

pros: Unlimited access to designated free models, separate from credits
Free tier with 8K memory is testable before paying
Voice messages and custom voices at paid tiers
Clear tier breakdown once you switch to monthly billing
cons: Free chat history deleted after 7 days of inactivity
Annual-equivalent headline easily confused with monthly cost
Native apps claimed in FAQ with no verified store listing
Trust review verdict: avoid — reported lack of self-serve cancel, non-refundable terms, and payment-processor churn
Community-reported: no confirmed encryption, heavy third-party tracking (~45 trackers), and chat-log collection
Low customer support ratings on Trustpilot (~1.8/5 reported)
